In the UK, the use of epoetins or their analogues is not generally recommended4 for chemother- apy-related anaemia except, in combination with intravenous iron, in patients in whom anaemia is profound and likely to affect survival, and who cannot be given blood transfusions, or in women given platinum-based chemotherapy for ovarian cancer in whom haemoglobin has fallen to 8 g per 100 mL or less. 1.
